verdict.rationale: Attio's per-endpoint REST reference pages include a live in-browser "Try it" API playground, so each documented endpoint can be run directly. The reference is backed by a public OpenAPI 3.1 document at api.attio.com/openapi/api. The 404s on docs.attio.com OpenAPI paths only show the spec lives on a different host, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the playground works end-to-end, and explicit evidence of runnable code samples across languages.
